review_method: Read-only source review; no test, typecheck, build or audit rerun by this reviewer.
outcome: No remaining confirmed blocker in the reviewed frontend scope after the two reported findings were fixed.

findings_resolved.finding: RetainedEvidence rendered zero cells for valid nonempty catalogue/documentary rows when receipt.columns was empty.
findings_resolved.resolution: Zero-column pages now render exact retained rows as literal JSON objects with React escaping, preserving independently paged bytes.
findings_resolved.regression: frontend-v1/tests/research-answers-view.test.ts covers actual documentary quotation and catalogue relationship payload without a preview fallback.

findings_resolved.finding: Generic recursive scope discovery mistook arbitrary quoted receipt-shaped scientific rows/answer details for protocol EvidenceReceipt objects.
findings_resolved.resolution: Scope semantic validation now uses only actual generated schema receipt positions and directly requested EvidenceScope/EvidenceReceipt roots; quoted payload data remains literal.
findings_resolved.regression: frontend-v1/tests/research-evidence-service.test.ts accepts receipt-shaped quoted rows/details while still rejecting malformed real receipt scopes.

additional_hardening_reviewed: Generated-schema property and definition lookup uses Object.hasOwn so inherited constructor/__proto__/toString names cannot bypass strict envelope field validation.
reviewed_boundaries: Nine separate answer/evidence actions use explicit strict bounded transport without implicit read-side generation.
Current account/permission/conversation epochs and AbortSignal guards prevent stale responses from restoring private views.
Off-page selected answer recovery remains freshly authorized; arbitrary cached prose does not establish history.
Idempotency-key mutation intents retain original binding and survive uncertain acknowledgements; readonly polling pauses around mutations.
Answer/source authority, partial/unknown/known-zero distinctions, original snapshot binding, qualifications and receipt citations remain visible.
Evidence page/exports/attachments use retained receipt hash plus current authorization, preserve original binding and never narrow inventory automatically.
React renders literal source values; no raw HTML or private answer body browser storage was introduced.

supporting_verification.owner_reported_typecheck_build_audit: Pass; production dependency audit zero vulnerabilities
supporting_verification.reviewer_verification: All 19 current source pins exactly match the reviewed source map. Supporting test logs were not rerun.

qualifications: This is scoped source review, not an assembled browser/system acceptance claim.
Backend current-authority, retention, lease/budget and final publication guarantees require their separate source-bound acceptance evidence.
No live provider, GCP deployment, real-data transfer or independent scientific approval was performed.
